notes: Summary: strong fit on perf and batching; stalled due to integration friction + security gating.
Key quote from CTO: "We love the benchmarks, but without native tracing headers and a supported SSO/OIDC flow we can't finish the security sign-off."
Integration pain points called out repeatedly: no first-class Rust SDK, Go SDK missing streaming callbacks, lack of documented header-level correlation_id for tracing.
Security: security team redlined absence of audit log retention policy and no KMS/HSM integration in private offering. Asked for signed ISO27001 evidence.
Observability: engineering team requires OpenTelemetry-compatible propagation (traceparent / tracestate) and the ability to attach internal span IDs to Redwood requests for cross-service traces.
Auth: procurement/security want OIDC-based SSO + SCIM for provisioning; current SAML-only docs unclear about automated provisioning.

Workarounds discussed: 1) temporary gateway to inject trace headers, 2) engineering support to ship a community Rust SDK, 3) short-term audit log export via API. All require product/eng buy-in and timelines we couldn't guarantee within their procurement window.

Competitive loss note: Cerulean chose NimbusAI in part because Nimbus shipped a native OpenTelemetry exporter, prebuilt SSO connectors, and a small integration team for the POC. Pricing was comparable.
